title: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem_agent role, which every PEM agent login inherits, is a member of the…
description: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), the pem_agent role inherited by every PEM agent login was a member of the pg_read_server_files and pg_write_server_files roles on the PEM backend database. This allowed an attacker controlling any monitored host and its PEM agent certificate to read and write files on the PEM server host as the postgres OS user, including the PEM certificate authority key. This vulnerability enables the attacker to issue certificates for other agents and impersonate them. Starting from PEM version 10.6.1, agents no longer hold these roles, mitigating the issue.
